newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Res to buy chemical plant - paper.
newsitem.headline: China Res to buy chemical plant - paper.

text.p: China Resources Enterprise Ltd will finalise terms on the purchase of a chemical plant in Dalian in China's northeastern province of Liaoning by the end of 1996, the Hong Kong Economic Times reported on Tuesday.
The daily quoted managing director Frank Ning as saying the group would sign a contract for the purchase of a 90 percent stake in the plant by year-end.
Some 200 million to 300 million yuan was expected to be required to upgrade the plant's production facilities, he said.
Ning was also quoted as saying the group was in talks to invest in beer brewers in China but the group did not have any immediate plan to expand its brewing business.
Group officials were not immediately available for comment.
